use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

#[test]
fn matches_java_adapter_outputs() {
    const ROOT: &str = "urn:rust-proof:root";
    const LIB: &str = "urn:rust-proof:lib";
    let text = Value::Text("Grüezi 🌍\n\"FEEL\"".into());
    let mut inputs = BTreeMap::from([((ROOT, "text"), text.clone()), ((ROOT, "amount"), Value::Null)]);
    let exact = Value::Number {
        coefficient: concat!("12345678901234567890", "000012500").into(),
        scale: 9,
    };
    assert_eq!(evaluate(&inputs).unwrap(), BTreeMap::from([
        ((LIB, "rate"), exact.clone()),
        ((ROOT, "rate"), exact),
        ((ROOT, "echo"), text),
        ((ROOT, "nullable"), Value::Null),
        ((ROOT, "flag"), Value::Boolean(false)),
    ]));
    inputs.remove(&(ROOT, "amount"));
    assert_eq!(evaluate(&inputs), Err("missing input"));
}
